reuse.why: The change reuses category selection, amount conversion, batching and undo registration, but implements tag recognition instead of using extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: Budget eligibility remains centralized, but FIXED_TAG duplicates tag recognition already provided by shared/tags.ts.

placement.why: Eligibility and budget calculations remain in budget/actions.ts, with method registration in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested bulk-action policies, new action, registration and related tests.

maintainability.why: The shared selection function keeps all bulk consumers aligned, though a separate tag grammar creates an avoidable maintenance burden.

disguised_duplication.where: FIXED_TAG reshapes the existing shared tag-recognition logic into a dedicated regular expression.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories retains its existing parameters; the new exclusions are shared policies, and every affected bulk action continues to use it.
